vitamin c in serum aa2g

94% ingredients of natural origin

Shows concentrated anti-ageing activity. Reduces wrinkles. Evens out the skin tone.

How to use

Apply the serum on the face, neck and décolleté. Apply depending on the selected cosmetic treatment (ultrasounds, needle-free mesotherapy, sonophoresis, non-invasive derma-rollers) or manually. May be used as home care.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Panthenol, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Propylene Glycol, Potassium Hydroxide, Dimethylmethoxy Chromanyl Palmitate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Carbomer, Dimethicone, Sodium Citrate, Pentylene Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydroxyacetophenone, Parfum (Fragrance), Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Limonene, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Linalool, Citric Acid.

The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2025-06.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

provitamin B5 (D-panthenol), vitamin C, tyrosinase inhibitor
